verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI advertises automation hooks (non-interactive scripting, GitHub Actions PR review/issue triage/on-demand assistance) that could support building and reviewing features, but there is no evidence of a genuine 'cloud agent' that autonomously builds, tests, and demos a full feature end-to-end. Multiple community reports describe the agentic mode as unreliable—getting stuck in loops, failing basic file operations, and even causing catastrophic data loss—directly undercutting vendor claims of dependable autonomous task completion.
